item.description: "48 Hours" uncovers the narrative behind true crime cases with unmatched reporting and suspense.

item.title: Detectives use chewing gum sting to catch elusive murder suspect
item.description: A detective in Everett, Washington, linked two cold case killings to a known predator. She helped devise a clever undercover operation to obtain fresh DNA for charges.

item.title: Over 1,800 arrested in France amid protester violence
item.description: Police used tear gas to disperse individuals in hoods and masks throwing fireworks and objects at officers in Place de la République.

item.title: Fire erupts after deadly incident at Canadian military base
item.description: Canada's defense minister said Saturday that people were killed and injured in an incident at an Alberta military base that caused a major fire.
